blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Jose Rizal University halted College of St. Benilde’s hot start in Group A of the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament after hanging tough in the stretch to pull out a 73-69 victory at San Juan Arena on Tuesday. Laurence Mangubat finished with 20 points and Chris Hubilla was also big in the stretch as the Heavy Bombers rose to 2-0 while dealing the Blazers their first defeat after conquests of defending champion San Beda and Lyceum.
